receipt.callable_reasoning: Authorizes actor then loads service. Optional Name normalized, rejects blank and detects other-ID name clash before Save. Updates fee only when nonnull, so nullable fee cannot be cleared to null through this request; Active optionally toggles. No monetary sign/max validation, no row concurrency token/name-admission lock, no historical order rewrite. Concurrent updates can be last-writer-wins and name predicate races; no live DB acceptance claimed.

disposition.conclusion: Supplemental configuration-ingress evidence: UpdateDeliveryServiceHandler permits an authorized delivery_manage request to persist a signed fee without server sign/magnitude validation. The active-service query and cashier checkout path subsequently carry the configured amount into signed fee arithmetic. This is the same missing server-side fee invariant covered by FIN-016; extend its evidence/affected paths rather than create a duplicate finding.
disposition.confirmed: Static source behavior and wiring only. No live HTTP/API acceptance, SQL persistence, cashier checkout or financial side effect executed.
disposition.owner_policy: Nonnegative/maximum fee policy and nullable null-versus-clear semantics remain unresolved.
